simple: Encrypts files on every reachable computer and server and demands a ransom for the key — often also threatening to publish stolen data.
analogy: Puts locks on all the cabinets and demands money for the keys.
quote: All the files have a .locked extension and there’s a ransom note
questions: Do you have offline copies that ransomware can’t encrypt?
Have you tested restoring from backups?
Do you have a plan for what to do if files get encrypted?
